notes: The owner can now forget a source from the chat, and the model cannot. A new /forget command lives in the service command layer, which answers before the model pipeline runs, and no tool is registered for it - so nothing a model writes, and nothing written into a session, can produce a forget. Only the owner reaches it, through the service's own allowlist. The flow is two steps: /forget with a word lists the matching sources, each with a short random one-shot code, and /forget confirm with that code performs the write. Candidates are labelled, never quoted - a heading for a stored entry, the token for a derived item - so no body, excerpt, path or credential appears in a reply, and the query itself is never echoed back. A wrong, expired, reused or unknown code writes nothing and says so. Only one pending list exists per chat, it expires after five minutes and lives in the per-profile state root. As everywhere in this feature, nothing is deleted: a tombstone is recorded, the entry stays in its file, and the read paths stop showing it - and the reply says that plainly. The counts move with the feature: 2932 core assertions and 1909 locale keys per pack, with a new gate for the flow. No new credential, no new outbound path, no change to any shared gateway.
